_comment: WHAT THIS IS. What the GM can do to the world: locations and the actions available there. The AI speaker may only MENTION these actions in conversation; they are applied solely from the GM console (run_master.py) and only after an explicit confirmation. Format: location → list of actions + state.

action_details._comment: combat: true — confirming it raises the 'put the laptop down' signal. consequence — what it means at the table. phrases — words the guard uses to catch the model claiming an action that was never confirmed.

lockdown.description: Sealing the door of the room
lockdown.consequence: The party is locked in and needs a way out

cut_lights.consequence: Darkness: disadvantage on perception without a light source

system_hint.description: The system volunteers the door code
system_hint.consequence: The party gets the code {{door_code}} without a fight — a reward for a good conversation
